title: net1 v7's traffic head refitted with every stock controller but the held-out two, and its belief beside those two
description: On the test links, the learned net2 reading the refitted traffic head gained 0.50 among copies but lost 0.11 beside BBRv3 and Westwood, the competitors no training data had (exp-traffic-head-test-309). The head's class 'another TCP flow' was fitted on two of its members only, Cubic and BBRv1 (family new, exp-traffic-head-v7-300 and exp-traffic-head-v7-agg-306). This gathers training-link data (campaign seed 1, 30 s, steps kept) beside one flow from 0 s of each of the 15 other stock controllers (family stock-all, BBRv3 and Westwood still held out), with three observed flows: the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v7 (rule-v7) and, so that the data covers the closed loop, round 33's net2 reading the head of 306 (net2-r33hn-s1, t 0.7, tq 0.3) and round 29's rules with both beliefs from it (net2-v7hpn-s1, t 0.5, tq 0.5); then refits the head on it with the data of 300 and 306. Beside BBRv3 and Westwood from 0 s on the validation links (campaign seed 21, 60 s), it observes rule-v7 and net2-r33hn-s1 and scores both heads on those steps by time since the episode began: what the head of 306 believed there, and whether the refit believes a stock flow. Reading, stated before the results: the refit is worth a validation run of net2 if, with rule-v7 observed, it calls those flows copies in at most 10% of steps at every age from 10 s on.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; d="$OUT/runs/r29-s1"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s1.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s1.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" net2-v7hpn-s1 "$d" --t 0.5 --tq 0.5 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s1"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s1"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cp "$G" "$e/traffic_head.pt"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" net2-r33hn-s1 "$e" --t 0.7 --tq 0.3 --traffic "$G"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "net2-r33hn-s1=$OUT/p/net2-r33hn-s1.onnx" --policy "net2-v7hpn-s1=$OUT/p/net2-v7hpn-s1.onnx"); uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-stock-all" --split train --family stock-all --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-stock-all/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-stock-all"; for n in "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" "net2-r33hn-s1=$OUT/p/net2-r33hn-s1.onnx"; do a=${n%%=*}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$a-held" --split val --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 21 --stock "" --policy "$n"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$a-held/campaign.json" "$OUT/obs-$a/c-held-competitors"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-* "$OUT"/obs-*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: N="$IN/t/net1-v7.pt"; G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; mkdir -p "$OUT/agg"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do ln -s "../$(basename "$c")" "$OUT/agg/"; done; for c in "$IN/n"/c-*; do ln -s "$c" "$OUT/agg/c-agg-${c##*/c-}"; done; for c in "$IN/old"/c-*; do ln -s "$c" "$OUT/agg/c-old-${c##*/c-}"; done; uv run python experiments/traffic_head.py "$OUT/agg" "$N"; cp "$OUT/agg/traffic_head.pt" "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"; for a in rule-v7 net2-r33hn-s1; do for h in new old; do f="$OUT/traffic_head.pt"; [ "$h" = old ] && f="$G"; mkdir -p "$OUT/val-$h-$a"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head_val.py "$OUT/val-$h-$a" "$OUT/obs-$a" "$N" "$f"; done; done; { echo "## The refitted head, on the training links of runs 300, 306 and this run"; echo; cat "$OUT/agg/summary.md"; echo; for a in rule-v7 net2-r33hn-s1; do for h in new old; do echo "## Head $h ($([ "$h" = new ] && echo this run || echo run 306)), BBRv3 and Westwood on the validation links, observed flow $a"; echo; cat "$OUT/val-$h-$a/summary.md"; echo; done; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"; rm "$OUT"/agg/c-*; rm -f "$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25-actor.pt"; rm -rf "$IN/n" "$IN/old"; sha256sum "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"
